topic: Jamini Roy Folk Rejection of Academic Art
questionText:
Given below are two statements:
Statement I: Jamini Roy deliberately rejected his formal British academic training and Bengal wash style to embrace the raw, earthy folk idiom of Bengal village patuas.
Statement II: Jamini Roy painted exclusively with imported French oil paints on giant linen canvases.

In the light of the above statements, choose the most appropriate answer from the options given below:

options.text: Both Statement I and Statement II are correct
options.mistakeAnalysis: Erroneously assumed both statements were valid.

options.text: Both Statement I and Statement II are incorrect
options.mistakeAnalysis: Rejected valid scientific statements erroneously.

options.text: Statement I is correct but Statement II is incorrect
options.mistakeAnalysis: Correct answer. Statement I is true while Statement II contains a factual error.

options.text: Statement I is incorrect but Statement II is correct
options.mistakeAnalysis: Failed to recognize the fallacy in Statement I.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
Statement I is correct: Jamini Roy abandoned academic realism and wash painting to revive folk art. Statement II is incorrect: he completely discarded Western oil paints, formulating his own natural earth pigments applied in flat gouache/tempera.
Hence, Option B is correct.
Hence, option (C) is correct.
